Proetus , i, m., = Προῖτος,
I.a king of Tiryns, brother of Acrisius, Ov. M. 5, 238 sq. —Proetĭdes , um, f., = Προιτιδες, his daughters, who being punished with madness by Juno for their pride, imagined themselves to be cows: “Proetides implerunt falsis mugitibus agros,” Verg. E. 6, 48 ; Ov. M. 15, 326; Plin. 25, 5, 21, § 47.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
